reason: The cumulative diagnostic jumped from N499 to N504, so N504 is the first emitted checkpoint at or beyond the preregistered N500 watershed.

phaseCheckpoints.note: N353 is the first retained checkpoint near the planned N350 phase boundary.

truthAssessment.baseline: The frozen post-N250 holdout is slightly positive overall, but far below the +0.10R expectancy proof gate and highly phase-dependent.
truthAssessment.nonstationarity: Strongly observed: phase expectancy moved from -0.384R to +0.268R, then near-flat and positive phases. Static relationships changed sign and magnitude.
truthAssessment.exit: Both BE shadows improved the frozen holdout aggregate, but neither is promoted live from this evidence alone.
truthAssessment.score: The 0.90-0.95 bucket added exactly 0R after N250 despite looking positive cumulatively, so its apparent cumulative edge was not forward-confirmed in this holdout.
truthAssessment.spread: 1-2bps is positive across the full holdout but had a severe negative N250-N300 phase, so a fixed spread rule is not justified.
truthAssessment.structure: RANGE is the strongest broad structural candidate in this holdout; MIXED is strongly negative. Both remain observational/correlated rather than causal or proven.
truthAssessment.rejectedShadowCandidate: STRUCTURE_EDGE_CONSISTENT performed poorly and should not be prioritized as a future live gate in its current definition.
truthAssessment.volatility: Almost all samples are EXTREME_VOL, so the current volatility overlay has little discriminatory value.
truthAssessment.masterBrainGate: FAIL: baseline holdout expectancy +0.014R is below the required +0.10R. PF, drawdown and lower-confidence-bound cannot be established from these cumulative aggregates alone.

nextResearchDirection: Use the completed watershed evidence to design a preregistered phase-aware Dynamic Expected-R model with long-term shrinkage, recent-window evidence, change detection and abstention; test only on a new future holdout before any live promotion.
